title: A Portrait for the Cellar
author: Oscar Montrose
blurb: Xanthe Galloway, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
